results.question: How many customers do we have?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM sales.Customers
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomerCount
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS c;

results.question: How many customers are based in Pakistan?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM sales.Customers WHERE CountryCode = 'PK'

results.question: How many active corporate customers are there?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM sales.Customers WHERE Segment = 'Corporate' AND IsActive = 1
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS ActiveCorporateCustomerCount
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS c
WHERE c.[IsActive] = 1
  AND c.[Segment] = 'Corporate';

results.question: How many orders were cancelled in 2025?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM sales.Orders WHERE Status = 'Cancelled' AND OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CancelledOrderCount
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
WHERE o.[Status] = 'Cancelled'
  AND o.[OrderDate] >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.[OrderDate] < '2026-01-01';

results.question: What is the total gross sales across all order items, i.e. quantity times unit price before any discount?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(Quantity * UnitPrice) AS GrossSales FROM sales.OrderItems

results.question: What was total net revenue (quantity × unit price × (1 − discount)) from delivered orders placed in 2024?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.Status = 'Delivered' AND o.OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2025-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CAST(oi.Quantity AS decimal(18,4)) * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS TotalNetRevenue
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId
WHERE o.Status = 'Delivered'
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2024-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2025-01-01';

results.question: What was net revenue by customer country code in 2025?
results.goldSql: SELECT c.CountryCode, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY c.CountryCode
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.CountryCode,
    SUM(v.NetRevenue) AS NetRevenue
FROM [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS v
JOIN [sales].[Customers] AS c
    ON c.CustomerId = v.CustomerId
WHERE v.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND v.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY c.CountryCode;

results.question: Which 5 products generated the most net revenue overall? Show product name and net revenue, highest first.
results.goldSql: SELECT TOP (5) WITH TIES p.ProductName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId GROUP BY p.ProductName ORDER BY NetRevenue DESC
results.sql:
SELECT TOP (5) WITH TIES
    p.[ProductName],
    SUM(oi.[Quantity] * oi.[UnitPrice] * (1 - oi.[DiscountPct])) AS [NetRevenue]
FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.[ProductId] = oi.[ProductId]
GROUP BY p.[ProductId], p.[ProductName]
ORDER BY [NetRevenue] DESC;

results.question: Which month of 2024 had the most orders? Give the month number and order count.
results.goldSql: SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES MONTH(OrderDate) AS MonthNumber, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM sales.Orders WHERE OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND OrderDate < '2025-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(OrderDate) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
results.sql:
SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES
    MONTH(o.[OrderDate]) AS [MonthNumber],
    COUNT(*) AS [OrderCount]
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
WHERE o.[OrderDate] >= '2024-01-01'
  AND o.[OrderDate] < '2025-01-01'
GROUP BY MONTH(o.[OrderDate])
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

results.question: What is the average quantity per order line?
results.goldSql: SELECT AVG(CAST(Quantity AS decimal(18,4))) AS AvgQuantity FROM sales.OrderItems
results.sql:
SELECT AVG(CAST([oi].[Quantity] AS decimal(18,4))) AS [AverageQuantityPerOrderLine]
FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS [oi];

results.question: What percentage of all orders were placed through the web channel? Answer as a number between 0 and 100.
results.goldSql: SELECT 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Channel = 'Web' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS WebPct FROM sales.Orders
results.sql:
SELECT
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(CASE WHEN o.[Channel] = 'Web' THEN 1 END)
         / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS decimal(18,4)) AS [WebOrderPercentage]
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o;

results.question: For each sales channel, what percentage of its orders were cancelled (0-100)?
results.goldSql: SELECT Channel, 100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN Status = 'Cancelled' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) / COUNT(*) AS CancelledPct FROM sales.Orders GROUP BY Channel
results.sql:
SELECT
    [o].[Channel],
    CAST(100.0 * COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN [o].[Status] = 'Cancelled' THEN [o].[OrderId] END)
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT [o].[OrderId]), 0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS [CancelledOrderPercentage]
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS [o]
GROUP BY [o].[Channel];

results.question: How many customers have never placed an order?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM sales.Customers c WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.Orders o WHERE o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId)
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS CustomersWithNoOrders
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS c
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
    WHERE o.[CustomerId] = c.[CustomerId]
);

results.question: List the names of products that have never been sold.
results.goldSql: SELECT p.ProductName FROM catalog.Products p WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sales.OrderItems oi WHERE oi.ProductId = p.ProductId)
results.sql:
SELECT p.[ProductName]
FROM [catalog].[Products] AS p
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    WHERE oi.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId]
);

results.question: List every sales rep's full name together with their manager's full name.
results.goldSql: SELECT e.FullName AS SalesRep, m.FullName AS Manager FROM hr.Employees e JOIN hr.Employees m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ManagerId WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Rep'
results.sql:
SELECT
    e.[FullName] AS [SalesRepFullName],
    m.[FullName] AS [ManagerFullName]
FROM [hr].[Employees] AS e
LEFT JOIN [hr].[Employees] AS m
    ON e.[ManagerId] = m.[EmployeeId]
WHERE e.[Title] = 'Sales Rep';

results.question: Which manager has the most direct reports? Give the manager's name and the number of direct reports.
results.goldSql: SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES m.FullName, COUNT(*) AS DirectReports FROM hr.Employees e JOIN hr.Employees m ON m.EmployeeId = e.ManagerId GROUP BY m.EmployeeId, m.FullName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
results.sql:
SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES
    m.[FullName] AS [ManagerName],
    COUNT(e.[EmployeeId]) AS [DirectReportCount]
FROM [hr].[Employees] AS m
JOIN [hr].[Employees] AS e
    ON e.[ManagerId] = m.[EmployeeId]
GROUP BY m.[EmployeeId], m.[FullName]
ORDER BY COUNT(e.[EmployeeId]) DESC;

results.question: What is total net revenue for each top-level product category (the categories that have no parent)?
results.goldSql: SELECT parent.CategoryName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId JOIN catalog.Categories parent ON parent.CategoryId = c.ParentCategoryId GROUP BY parent.CategoryName
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.[CategoryName],
    SUM(oi.[Quantity] * oi.[UnitPrice] * (1 - oi.[DiscountPct])) AS [TotalNetRevenue]
FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS c
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.[CategoryId] = c.[CategoryId]
JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId]
WHERE c.[ParentCategoryId] IS NULL
GROUP BY c.[CategoryId], c.[CategoryName];

results.question: Which customers placed more than 40 orders? Give customer id and number of orders.
results.goldSql: SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM sales.Orders GROUP BY CustomerId HAVING COUNT(*) > 40
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.CustomerId,
    COUNT(o.OrderId) AS OrderCount
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS c
JOIN [sales].[Orders] AS o
    ON o.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId
HAVING COUNT(o.OrderId) > 40;

results.question: For each region, which sales rep generated the highest net revenue? Show region name, rep name and net revenue.
results.goldSql: WITH r AS (SELECT reg.RegionName, e.FullName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY reg.RegionName ORDER BY SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) DESC) AS rk FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId JOIN hr.Employees e ON e.EmployeeId = o.SalesRepId JOIN sales.Regions reg ON reg.RegionId = e.RegionId GROUP BY reg.RegionName, e.EmployeeId, e.FullName) SELECT RegionName, FullName, NetRevenue FROM r WHERE rk = 1
results.sql:
WITH RepRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.RegionId,
        e.EmployeeId,
        SUM(v.NetRevenue) AS NetRevenue
    FROM [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS v
    INNER JOIN [sales].[Orders] AS o
        ON o.OrderId = v.OrderId
    INNER JOIN [hr].[Employees] AS e
        ON e.EmployeeId = o.SalesRepId
    INNER JOIN [sales].[Regions] AS r
        ON r.RegionId = e.RegionId
    WHERE e.Title = 'Sales Rep'
    GROUP BY r.RegionId, e.EmployeeId
),
RankedRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        RegionId,
        EmployeeId,
        NetRevenue,
        RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY RegionId ORDER BY NetRevenue DESC) AS RevenueRank
    FROM RepRevenue
)
SELECT
    r.RegionName,
    e.FullName AS RepName,
    rr.NetRevenue
FROM RankedRevenue AS rr
INNER JOIN [sales].[Regions] AS r
    ON r.RegionId = rr.RegionId
INNER JOIN [hr].[Employees] AS e
    ON e.EmployeeId = rr.EmployeeId
WHERE rr.RevenueRank = 1;

results.question: Show monthly net revenue for 2025 with a running total: month number, revenue and cumulative revenue, in month order.
results.goldSql: WITH m AS (SELECT MONTH(o.OrderDate) AS MonthNumber, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY MONTH(o.OrderDate)) SELECT MonthNumber, NetRevenue, SUM(NetRevenue) OVER (ORDER BY MonthNumber ROWS UNBOUNDED PRECEDING) AS CumulativeRevenue FROM m
results.sql:
SELECT
    MONTH([v].[OrderDate]) AS [MonthNumber],
    SUM([v].[NetRevenue]) AS [Revenue],
    SUM(SUM([v].[NetRevenue])) OVER (
        ORDER BY MONTH([v].[OrderDate])
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW
    ) AS [CumulativeRevenue]
FROM [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS [v]
WHERE [v].[OrderDate] >= '2025-01-01'
  AND [v].[OrderDate] < '2026-01-01'
GROUP BY MONTH([v].[OrderDate])
ORDER BY [MonthNumber];

results.question: Compare net revenue in 2024 and 2025 for each channel: show channel, 2024 revenue and 2025 revenue.
results.goldSql: SELECT o.Channel, SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate < '2025-01-01' THEN oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct) ELSE 0 END) AS Revenue2024, SUM(CASE WHEN o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' THEN oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct) ELSE 0 END) AS Revenue2025 FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2024-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY o.Channel
results.sql:
SELECT
    [r].[Channel] AS [Channel],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [r].[OrderDate] >= '2024-01-01' AND [r].[OrderDate] < '2025-01-01' THEN [r].[NetRevenue] ELSE 0 END) AS [Revenue2024],
    SUM(CASE WHEN [r].[OrderDate] >= '2025-01-01' AND [r].[OrderDate] < '2026-01-01' THEN [r].[NetRevenue] ELSE 0 END) AS [Revenue2025]
FROM [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS [r]
WHERE ([r].[OrderDate] >= '2024-01-01' AND [r].[OrderDate] < '2025-01-01')
   OR ([r].[OrderDate] >= '2025-01-01' AND [r].[OrderDate] < '2026-01-01')
GROUP BY [r].[Channel];

results.question: How many distinct products were sold in December 2025?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.ProductId) AS Products FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN sales.Orders o ON o.OrderId = oi.OrderId WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-12-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT oi.ProductId) AS DistinctProductsSold
FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
JOIN [sales].[Orders] AS o
    ON o.OrderId = oi.OrderId
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-12-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
  AND o.Status <> 'Cancelled';

results.question: How many orders have no sales rep assigned?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM sales.Orders WHERE SalesRepId IS NULL

results.question: How many orders took more than 3 days to ship, counting days from the order date to the shipped date?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM sales.Orders WHERE ShippedDate IS NOT NULL AND DATEDIFF(day, CAST(OrderDate AS date), ShippedDate) > 3
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersShippedAfterMoreThan3Days
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
WHERE o.ShippedDate IS NOT NULL
  AND o.ShippedDate > DATEADD(DAY, 3, CAST(o.OrderDate AS date));

results.question: What is the total amount paid using digital wallets?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(Amount) AS Paid FROM sales.Payments WHERE Method = 'Wallet'

results.question: How many orders were paid in more than one payment?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Orders FROM (SELECT OrderId FROM sales.Payments GROUP BY OrderId HAVING COUNT(*) > 1) x
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS OrdersPaidInMoreThanOnePayment
FROM (
    SELECT p.OrderId
    FROM [sales].[Payments] AS p
    GROUP BY p.OrderId
    HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
) AS MultiPaymentOrders;

results.question: What was net revenue from customers in Dubai for laptops in 2025?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories cat ON cat.CategoryId = p.CategoryId WHERE c.City = 'Dubai' AND cat.CategoryName = 'Laptops' AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT
    SUM(CAST(oi.Quantity AS decimal(18,4)) * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue
FROM [sales].[Orders] AS o
JOIN [sales].[Customers] AS c
    ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId
JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId
WHERE c.City = 'Dubai'
  AND p.ProductName LIKE '%Laptop%'
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01';

results.question: What is the average net revenue per order for in-store orders?
results.goldSql: SELECT AVG(NetRevenue) AS AvgOrderRevenue FROM sales.vOrderRevenue WHERE Channel = 'Store'
results.sql:
SELECT
    AVG(CAST([v].[NetRevenue] AS decimal(18,4))) AS [AverageNetRevenuePerOrder]
FROM [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS [v]
WHERE [v].[Channel] = 'Store';

results.question: Who are our top 3 customers by lifetime net revenue? Show first name, last name and revenue.
results.goldSql: SELECT TOP (3) WITH TIES c.FirstName, c.LastName, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) AS NetRevenue FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName ORDER BY NetRevenue DESC
results.sql:
SELECT TOP (3) WITH TIES
    c.FirstName,
    c.LastName,
    SUM(r.NetRevenue) AS LifetimeNetRevenue
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS c
JOIN [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS r
    ON r.CustomerId = c.CustomerId
GROUP BY c.CustomerId, c.FirstName, c.LastName
ORDER BY SUM(r.NetRevenue) DESC;

results.question: What is the gross margin for the Audio category, defined as net revenue minus product unit cost times quantity?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct) - p.UnitCost * oi.Quantity) AS GrossMargin FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN catalog.Categories c ON c.CategoryId = p.CategoryId WHERE c.CategoryName = 'Audio'
results.sql:
SELECT
    c.[CategoryName],
    SUM(oi.[Quantity] * oi.[UnitPrice] * (1 - oi.[DiscountPct]))
      - SUM(oi.[Quantity] * p.[UnitCost]) AS [GrossMargin]
FROM [catalog].[Categories] AS c
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.[CategoryId] = c.[CategoryId]
JOIN [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
    ON oi.[ProductId] = p.[ProductId]
WHERE c.[CategoryName] = 'Audio'
GROUP BY c.[CategoryName];

results.question: How many order lines had a 20% discount?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Lines FROM sales.OrderItems WHERE DiscountPct = 0.20

results.question: How many customers signed up in each year? Show the year and the count.
results.goldSql: SELECT YEAR(SignupDate) AS SignupYear, COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM sales.Customers GROUP BY YEAR(SignupDate)
results.sql:
SELECT
    YEAR(c.[SignupDate]) AS [SignupYear],
    COUNT(*) AS [CustomerCount]
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS c
GROUP BY YEAR(c.[SignupDate])
ORDER BY [SignupYear];

results.question: How many customers were referred by another customer?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Customers FROM sales.Customers WHERE ReferredByCustomerId IS NOT NULL

results.question: Which customer referred the most other customers? Give their first name, last name and the number of referrals.
results.goldSql: SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES r.FirstName, r.LastName, COUNT(*) AS Referrals FROM sales.Customers c JOIN sales.Customers r ON r.CustomerId = c.ReferredByCustomerId GROUP BY r.CustomerId, r.FirstName, r.LastName ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
results.sql:
SELECT TOP (1) WITH TIES
    Referrer.FirstName,
    Referrer.LastName,
    COUNT(*) AS ReferralCount
FROM [sales].[Customers] AS Referrer
JOIN [sales].[Customers] AS Referred
    ON Referred.ReferredByCustomerId = Referrer.CustomerId
GROUP BY Referrer.CustomerId, Referrer.FirstName, Referrer.LastName
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC;

results.question: How many units of discontinued products were sold in 2025?
results.goldSql: SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity) AS Units FROM sales.OrderItems oi JOIN catalog.Products p ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId JOIN sales.Orders o ON o.OrderId = oi.OrderId WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1 AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(oi.Quantity) AS UnitsSold
FROM [sales].[OrderItems] AS oi
JOIN [sales].[Orders] AS o
    ON o.OrderId = oi.OrderId
JOIN [catalog].[Products] AS p
    ON p.ProductId = oi.ProductId
WHERE p.IsDiscontinued = 1
  AND o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
  AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
  AND o.Status <> 'Cancelled';

results.question: What share of 2025 net revenue came from each customer region? Give region name and percentage (0-100).
results.goldSql: SELECT reg.RegionName, 100.0 * SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct)) / SUM(SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice * (1 - oi.DiscountPct))) OVER () AS SharePct FROM sales.Orders o JOIN sales.OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderId = o.OrderId JOIN sales.Customers c ON c.CustomerId = o.CustomerId JOIN sales.Regions reg ON reg.RegionId = c.RegionId WHERE o.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01' AND o.OrderDate < '2026-01-01' GROUP BY reg.RegionName
results.sql:
WITH RegionRevenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.RegionId,
        r.RegionName,
        SUM(v.NetRevenue) AS NetRevenue
    FROM [sales].[vOrderRevenue] AS v
    INNER JOIN [sales].[Customers] AS c
        ON c.CustomerId = v.CustomerId
    INNER JOIN [sales].[Regions] AS r
        ON r.RegionId = c.RegionId
    WHERE v.OrderDate >= '2025-01-01'
      AND v.OrderDate < '2026-01-01'
    GROUP BY r.RegionId, r.RegionName
)
SELECT
    RegionName,
    CAST(100.0 * NetRevenue / NULLIF(SUM(NetRevenue) OVER (), 0) AS decimal(18,2)) AS RevenueSharePercent
FROM RegionRevenue
ORDER BY RegionName;

results.question: How many sales reps were hired before 2021?
results.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS Reps FROM hr.Employees WHERE Title = 'Sales Rep' AND HireDate < '2021-01-01'
results.sql:
SELECT COUNT(*) AS SalesRepCount
FROM [hr].[Employees] AS e
WHERE e.[Title] = 'Sales Rep'
  AND e.[HireDate] < '2021-01-01';
